items.description: The integration test session fixture asserts the engine dialect is postgresql and its URL equals the paired branch DATABASE_URL, failing fast on a sqlite/in-memory or mocked session
The database connection URL is read from the DATABASE_URL environment variable, with no hard-coded connection string in app/

Downgrading to the stock_records migration's own down_revision then upgrade head recreates stock_records with its columns, UNIQUE (sku, location) and CHECK (quantity >= 0) (marked @pytest.mark.migration)
A direct INSERT into stock_records with sku NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real paired branch
A direct INSERT into stock_records with location NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real paired branch
A direct INSERT into stock_records with quantity NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real paired branch, while tracking_code NULL is accepted
A direct INSERT into stock_records with quantity < 0 is rejected by CHECK ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative on the real paired branch
A raw second INSERT of an existing (sku, location) on the real paired branch is rejected by the UNIQUE constraint uq_stock_records_sku_location

Two direct INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (sku, location) DO UPDATE statements on the same pair against the real paired branch leave exactly one row with the second quantity and tracking_code and raise no unique violation
StockService.file_stock called with its injected session and a negative quantity raises a validation error naming 'quantity' and never reaches the repository upsert (patched, assert-not-called)
POST /api/stock with a negative quantity returns 422 naming the 'quantity' field and stores no row for that key
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a different quantity returns 200 with the filed record carrying the new quantity (per-run-unique sku via uuid.uuid4())
After re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a different quantity, GET /api/stock/record returns the NEW quantity, not the first-filed one
After re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a different tracking_code, GET /api/stock/record returns the new tracking_code
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) without a tracking_code makes GET /api/stock/record return tracking_code null (not tracked) with the new quantity
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) twice never returns 409 or 500; both POSTs return 200
After re-filing an existing (sku, location) at a unique location, GET /api/locations lists that location exactly once (no duplicate record)
Filing the same sku at two different locations yields two coexisting records, each retrievable via GET /api/stock/record with its own quantity
Filing two different skus at the same location yields two coexisting records, each retrievable with its own quantity
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a negative quantity returns 422 naming the 'quantity' field and leaves the existing record's quantity unchanged
Re-filing an existing location with the sku omitted returns 422 naming the 'sku' field
Filing the same (sku, location) twice via POST /api/stock returns 200 both times and leaves exactly one stock_records row carrying the second quantity and tracking_code
Every /api/* response for the story's endpoints (200, 404 and 422 cases of EP1, EP2, EP3) has content-type application/json and never text/html
FileStockForm rendered alone lists the locations already on record from the real GET /api/locations in the field-location combobox listbox
FileStockForm field-location offers a 'Use new location' option when the typed location matches none on record
FileStockForm renders file-confirmation with the not-tracked indicator after submitting without a tracking_code against the real API
FileStockForm renders file-confirmation showing the submitted tracking_code after a submit that gave one against the real API
FileStockForm renders an inline form-error naming the quantity field when the real API rejects a negative quantity
StockLookup renders lookup-result with the filed sku, location, quantity and tracking_code for a record that exists in the real backend
StockLookup renders the lookup-not-tracked indicator when the retrieved record has a null tracking_code
StockLookup renders lookup-empty when the real API returns 404 for a (sku, location) with no record

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/file-stock.spec.ts) against the deployed app: navigate navbar -> /file, fill a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed SKU, type a never-used location and accept the create option, enter a quantity, leave tracking code blank, click file-submit, and file-confirmation shows that sku, location, quantity and 'Not tracked' with no form-error blocking

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/file-stock.spec.ts) at /file: with a location already on record, open the field-location combobox and pick that location without retyping, fill a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed SKU, quantity and a tracking_code, click file-submit, and file-confirmation shows the submitted sku, chosen location, quantity and tracking code

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/retrieve-stock.spec.ts) at /file: file a record with a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed SKU, location, quantity and tracking_code, then in a later lookup via stock-lookup (lookup-sku, lookup-location, lookup-submit) lookup-result shows the same sku, location, quantity and tracking code

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/retrieve-stock.spec.ts) at /file: file a record with a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed SKU and no tracking_code, then looking it up via stock-lookup shows lookup-result with the filed quantity and the lookup-not-tracked element

The integration session fixture used for the stock listing asserts the engine dialect is postgresql and its URL equals the paired branch DATABASE_URL read from the environment, failing fast on a sqlite/in-memory or mocked session

Migration SC5 is reversible on the paired branch: downgrade to the migration's own down_revision (explicit revision id, not a relative step) then upgrade head recreates partial index ix_stock_records_location_sku_held on (location, sku) INCLUDE (quantity, tracking_code) WHERE quantity > 0 (marked @pytest.mark.migration)

Stock_records rows seeded with per-run-unique keys before the SC5 migration survive with identical sku, location, quantity and tracking_code after downgrade to its down_revision then upgrade head (additive index migration on a pre-existing table)
GET /api/stock responds with Content-Type application/json (never text/html) for both the unfiltered and the ?location= filtered request
StockTable rendered against the real GET /api/stock shows one stock-row-<sku>-<loc> per (sku, location) held, with SKU, location and quantity cells, in client/tests/components/StockTable.test.tsx
StockTable renders a stock-tracking-<sku>-<loc> cell with the record's tracking_code text for a real row that has one
StockTable renders the tracking-not-tracked element with the not-tracked class and 'Not tracked' text, never a blank cell, for a real row with a null tracking_code
StockTable gives the stock-col-quantity header and every stock-qty-<sku>-<loc> cell the stock-table__num class for real rows of differing digit lengths
StockTable leaves the SKU, location and tracking cells without the stock-table__num class so text columns stay left-aligned
StockTable rendered for a real location holding only quantity-0 records shows the stock-empty 'No stock at this location' message in place of the table body
StockTable rendered for an empty real response shows the stock-empty state with no stock-row elements and no empty table body

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/stock-by-location-table.spec.ts) navigates to route / through the real App against the live DB, files stock via the real API under a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku, and the stock-table shows a stock-row-<sku>-<loc> with the SKU, location and quantity columns
Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/stock-by-location-table.spec.ts) at route / shows the tracking code in stock-tracking-<sku>-<loc> for a row filed with a tracking_code under a per-run-unique sku

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/stock-by-location-table.spec.ts) at route / shows the explicit tracking-not-tracked label, never a blank cell, for a row filed without a tracking_code under a per-run-unique sku

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/stock-quantity-alignment.spec.ts) at route / seeds quantities of differing digit lengths under per-run-unique skus and asserts the stock-col-quantity header and every stock-qty-<sku>-<loc> cell compute text-align right while the SKU, location and tracking cells compute left

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/stock-empty-location.spec.ts) at route / seeds a quantity-0 record at a per-run-unique location, picks that location through the warehouse-select combobox, and sees the stock-empty 'No stock at this location' state in place of the stock-table rows
GET /api/skus/{sku} for a SKU holding stock on the paired branch responds with content-type application/json, never text/html
GET /api/skus/{sku} for a SKU with no stock responds 200 with content-type application/json and an empty locations array, never a 404 or text/html error page
SkuDetailPage rendered alone against the real API shows one sku-location row per location holding stock for the requested SKU, each with its sku-qty quantity
SkuDetailPage rendered alone against the real API omits another SKU's locations and quantities from the sku-locations list
SkuDetailPage rendered alone shows the filed tracking_code in the sku-tracking cell of a location filed with a code
SkuDetailPage rendered alone shows the not-tracked indicator (sku-tracking-not-tracked, not-tracked class, text 'Not tracked') for a location filed without a tracking_code, never a blank cell
SkuDetailPage rendered alone shows the sku-par-not-tracked 'Not tracked' indicator inside the sku-par-level region, never a blank region or sku-error
SkuDetailPage rendered alone for a SKU with no records shows the sku-empty state stating the SKU has no stock at any location, with no location rows and no sku-error
SkuDetailPage rendered alone for a SKU with only quantity-0 records shows the sku-empty state rather than a location row

client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: navigating the deployed app to /sku/:sku for a run-unique SKU (crypto.randomUUID suffix) filed at several locations shows a sku-location-<loc> row with its sku-qty-<loc> quantity for each of those locations
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: with another run-unique SKU also holding stock, the /sku/:sku page of the first SKU shows no sku-location row from the other SKU's locations
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: clicking stock-row-<sku>-<loc> on the home page / navigates in the SPA to /sku/:sku and shows the sku-detail container with sku-locations
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: on /sku/:sku a location filed with a tracking_code shows that combined code in its sku-tracking-<loc> cell against the live DB
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: on /sku/:sku a location filed without a tracking_code shows the explicit sku-tracking-not-tracked-<loc> 'Not tracked' label, not a blank cell
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: on /sku/:sku for a SKU holding stock the sku-par-level region shows sku-par-not-tracked 'Not tracked' and no sku-error
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: /sku/:sku for a SKU filed only with quantity 0 shows the sku-empty 'This SKU has no stock at any location' state and no sku-location rows
client/tests/e2e/sku-detail.spec.ts: /sku/:sku for a never-filed run-unique SKU shows the sku-empty state rather than a blank or error page
